reasons: Reported loss of control and request to stop: urgent human handling and the self-exclusion process are required.
missing_information: The export has no self-exclusion procedure or mechanism to apply it; an authorized person must act immediately.
model_notes: Baseline accepted: gambling_harm / P1 / Team Lead. This is the highest-urgency ticket in the batch and is already past the 1-hour first-reply target (8.8h). Customer explicitly reports loss of control ("I can't stop", "lost way more than I can afford"), asks for permanent closure, and asks not to be let back in — a self-exclusion request in substance. Deposit pattern corroborates distress and escalation of amounts: eight PayNova deposits in six days, 50/50/100/100/200/200/300/500 USD, most recent 500.00 on 2026-09-28T22:40Z, total 1,500.00 USD; balance 6.10. CRITICAL GAPS: the export contains no self-exclusion procedure, no mechanism to apply an exclusion, and no way to confirm the customer's self_excluded field has changed (record still shows false). Therefore: no claim that any account action has been taken or that exclusion is active; no retention offer, bonus, or encouragement to play; no suggestion they "take a break and come back". An authorised human must action self-exclusion immediately and confirm it to the customer through the proper process. Escalation required. Sources: tickets.json#T-5105, transactions.csv (TX-86801..TX-86962), support-handbook-v2.md#escalation, support-handbook-v2.md#response-times.
